messages.displayText:
You gotta hide so wild
Pokémon don’t spot you.

I wanna catch a Pokémon!
Got any tips for me?

Isn’t it cute when Pokémon
perch on streetlights?

The Number One Committee is in session! Today’s
topic: What’s the strongest Pokémon in Lumiose?

The same Pokémon can be stronger or weaker
depending on the Trainer, right?

Maybe the strongest Pokémon’s the one that the
best Trainer in the Z-A Royale uses most?

Nice of the Pokémon Center
to celebrate my birthday!

I’m happy to talk, but can we
do it somewhere more level?

We’re trying to track down a group that uses
Pokémon to do bad stuff. Seen anything fishy?

Pokémon belong at their Trainer’s side, and
Trainers belong at their Pokémon’s side.

Some people age like good cheese!
But most age like...bad cheese.

You don’t see many apartment
buildings with elevators here.

I’m really good with numbers!
But only if they’re about Pokémon.

Look at the nice view you get from up here! Even
Pokémon come to see it sometimes.

Tarragon might be a bit
too into his scaffolding.

My Pokémon respect me as their Trainer! That’s
my proof I’m a good person.

I wonder if that young Gym Leader
has been inventing anything new...

Even losing just once can
bring you down for a long time.

Between all the urban redevelopment work and
the Z-A Royale, things never settle down here.

Those cards you get in the Z-A
Royale are holo-tech, I hear!

Our family really can’t handle
keeping any more Pokémon.

Please, I really want this
Pokémon! It’s just one more!

Y’know something? Rest is
more important than work.

Why’s some foreign company being trusted
with a big deal like redeveloping Lumiose?

If we could speak with our Pokémon, I wonder if
we’d grow closer with them or end up fighting.

You were the one who challenged
me to a battle way back then, love.

No, no—you challenged me!
And I fell for you when you won!

Someday this scaffolding all over Lumiose will go
away and we’ll forget it ever existed.

Chilling with my
Pokémon is the best!

Pay attention to how big an area a move can hit!
You might think of some new battle ideas.

There’s so many things I wanna do together with
my Pokémon. I wish I could live forever!

I wonder if I’ll live long enough to make friends
with all the Pokémon in the world...

I want to try and battle all the strongest Trainers
in every last region there is!

Whether I’m productive or manage
nothing at all, the days slip on by...

If you have a Pokémon, then every
day is one shared with a partner!

Gah! No matter where I go,
I can’t escape my work!

All you actually have to do to be
an artist is declare yourself one.

I want to collect Kurt’s Poké Balls
and put them on display together!

I’m planning to do my own
Treasure Hunt in Lumiose!

Folks here sure do talk
to themselves a lot.

If I keep battling, I’m
bound to win sometime!

When Meowstic’s ears unfold, it...it... Aaagh!
I get the heebie-jeebies just thinking about it!

They say DYN4MO got started when people from
Racine Construction formed a group to act as<U+0010><U+0001>븀
bodyguards for Canari.

I can only hold it together
thanks to my Pokémon!

If I’m upset, giving my partner’s
Poké Ball a little squeeze helps.

It’s hard to keep winning forever. Even the
“unbeatable” Leon was eventually defeated.

I bet it’d be fun to have some kinda contest to
find each district’s strongest grade-schooler!

If I hope to understand how my Pokémon feel in
battle, first I’ve got to train and do battle myself!

“One must never stop reflecting.” That’s what my
master always used to say.
Let’s play office!

OK, then I’ll be the
one who gets paid!

Even if I win today,
I may lose tomorrow.

Let’s find lots of hidden treasure here in Lumiose
so we can make our fortune!

Treasure? You mean those Mega Stones? It’s true
that they do seem to be found all over lately.

I heard those Quasartico people have been findin’
Mega Stones during their construction work.

Whenever your Pokémon evolve, don’t forget to
check whether they’ve learned any new moves.

You can have your Pokémon learn moves of just
one type or a wide variety—it’s totally up to you.

You only live once, whether
you’re a person or a Pokémon!

Every café has its
own specialty. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

All these winding little streets...
Lumiose sure ain’t made for cars.

I’m completely beat... I wish
I could rest in a Poké Ball...

I simply spent my life enjoying every day to the
fullest, and before I knew it, I’d reached this age.

I know! Enjoying time with my friends and my
Pokémon caused me to evolve into an old woman!

Picking the right bonus cards is key if you want to
win in the Z-A Royale.

Teach your Pokémon plenty of different moves,
and you’ll be able to use any kind of bonus card.

Look, bonus cards are all well and good, but I’d
focus on getting in those surprise attacks!
My Staryu fell down from space!

Hmph, gotta stop thinking...
Crud! That’s a thought, too...

Whenever I meet a new Pokémon, I’m just like
“AHHH!” and “NO WAY!” and “GYAAAH!” Y’know?

I wonder what Pokémon we might meet just by
wandering around the city?

When my grampa died,
he left me his Garchomp.

W-wow, really?
Will it listen to you?

“I’m gonna Overheat on life!”
No? Hm, catchphrases are tough.

Do you think Pokémon enjoy the alone time they
get inside their Poké Balls?

When I got so sick I could hardly move, my sweet
Audino took such good care of me.

I get the feeling way more rocks and brambles
and things are appearing around town.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s getting to the point that you can hardly walk
the streets...

Well, they’re hardly insurmountable. Just have
your Pokémon use a move to clear them away.

This rooftop here is where
me and Krokorok camp out.

Don’t let others’ moods hold sway
over your own. They come and go.

Boy, every single place we’ve
visited so far has been great.

And every place we’ve got
coming up looks great too!

I tried eating a Berry that my
Pokémon was holding. Bad idea.

A nice swig of fresh water can
even make Pokémon feel better!

Oh, Pichu, you blessed thing.
Shocked yourself again, did you?

Just because the Z-A Royale exists doesn’t mean
all us adults are aiming to be the strongest.

Just like there are all kinds of Pokémon, there are
all kinds of things you can do when you grow up.

Is it tough to be a grown-up if you’re not good at
battling?

A lifetime wouldn’t be enough
to truly master Pokémon battles.

I don’t care how weak
it might be! I still love it!

Numel takes quadruple damage
from Water-type moves, right?

I got some e-books on sale...
Still haven’t read ’em, though.

How about a little competition to see who can
catch the biggest Pokémon?

I’m game, as long as you don’t care about how
big of a mess they’ll make in our tiny apartment.

I’ve just gotta get an alpha! That’s my ticket to
total victory!

OK, so base points are...
Nope! I still don’t get it!

I think...more base points
means you get higher stats?

I’ll tell you the truth, but only you. If you go
around to every one of Lumiose’s plazas in turn...<U+0010><U+0001>븀
nothing at all will happen...

I think I’m finally getting used to the smell of all
the Pokémon around here.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s weird, but now I sort of feel reassured when I
get a nice, strong whiff of them.

Perhaps someday people will fight directly against
Pokémon.

If a thing can be fixed, it’s worth thinking about.
But if it’s not going to get fixed, simply let it go.

I want a suuuper cute Pokémon
that’s also shockingly strong!

I want a really cool-looking
Pokémon as my partner!

I bet they’d make bank if they
brought back Super Training now!

I’m a genius at drawing portraits
that look nothing like their subject.
That Lebanne lady is preeetty darn tough!

Some Trainers look like they’d be even scarier in a
fight than their Pokémon!

I’d say that Ivor from the Fist of Justice would be
a prime example.

Tyranitar and Excadrill, no doubt.
I had the BEST Sandstorm team.

What Pokémon were your
favorite when you were young?

If only I had an undefeatable
Pokémon. I’d never worry then!

Imagine if all the Pokémon went
wild and attacked at once... Scary!

I saw this squishy green...well,
something when I was in Alola.

Do you think maybe
it was a Pokémon?

Aren’t there any apps that list up
all the moves a Pokémon learns?

My long years of experience have
left me peerless in the Z-A Royale.

Maybe I should start stunning my
targets with unexpected moves.

Geez, am I ever sick of getting dragged into
Pokémon battles when I’m trying to do my job!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Have you been hearing the same from the other
couriers you meet?

As the Zen masters try to teach us, “Every day is a
good day if you make it so.” I want to make it so.

The number of wild Pokémon keeps on increasing
in this city. Doesn’t that seem strange to you?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
And yet everyone’s acting like it’s a great thing!
Are they all just off their rockers or what?

I buy the finest ingredients for my Pokémon’s
meals, but they’re the ones that do the cooking.

What kind of items do you have your Pokémon
hold? I suppose Berries are tried-and-true...

You don’t have to battle in order
to enjoy time with your Pokémon!

Now that there are more Pokémon around, we’ve
gotta cover even more kinds of Pokémon in class!

How do TMs
actually work?

Some kids even memorize
all the Pokédex numbers!

It’s important to think about
how far away a move can hit!

The Jaune District has a lot
more stairs than other areas.

I’m not getting anywhere
with filling my Pokédex!

Do you think the Pokémon I’ve
sent to my Boxes are all right?

Feelings can’t be seen by anyone.
You’ve got to put them into words.

Vive le mode photo!
I just love it! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

They say that Absol is a Pokémon that can live an
incredibly long time—like one hundred years long!

You need a special stone to evolve a Clefairy. Did
you know that?

People seem to get it in their head
that coffee will wake them up.

The city, people, Pokémon...
Everything keeps changing.

I’m conducting research on how
the weather affects drink sales.

Oh, well, I simply apprenticed under a Pokémon
Professor by the name of Rowan long ago.

My gram-gram knows all about Pokémon! She
teaches me about every last one we see in town.

I’ve been training here in secret to improve my
rank in the Z-A Royale.

I forget—how tall
is Prism Tower?

I think it was...nearly
one thousand feet?

If people could become as strong as Pokémon,
I might not feel so uneasy living alongside them.<U+0010><U+0001>븀
But I suppose that’s too much to ask, huh?

Well, they say might makes right, after all!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I don’t think it’s a bad thing to do a little training
so you can defend yourself from Pokémon.

I want to go train in the wild!
Stupid wild zones don’t count!

I’m a ninth-degree black belt
in Pokémon! I just forgot my gi.
I just want to be as strong as Ivor-sensei!
Ivor-sensei may be strong, but he’s not invincible!

Doing martial arts helps me
understand my Pokémon!

Trainers should know the
pain their Pokémon face.

This is the Justice Dojo, training grounds for the
Fist of Justice.

Plus Moves
are the best!

Seeds of mastery!
I’ve gotta get some!
Pokémon are terrifying creatures.

I’m gonna take down the Fist of Justice! Then I’ll
be known far and wide as Lumiose’s strongest!

If you can master our Justice Punch technique,
you should be able to pulverize all sorts of things!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0011>

I love the serenity of a quiet night...but I also love
the Z-A Royale.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0012>

It’s great how training lets me
change myself for the better!

Ghost types grow more powerful
at night...at least, I think they do.

It’s so exciting to
pull an all-nighter!

Ivor-sensei’s rigid might... Gwynn’s light touch
and adaptability... They make a balanced team!

There are cardboard boxes stuffed haphazardly
with Fist of Justice equipment.

These Trevenant-themed training dummies are
handy for practicing strikes and kicks.

It’s an incline bench for doing sit-ups. A note on
it says “Off-limits for Ivor!” in small writing.

It’s a flag for the Fist of Justice with their logo
printed on it—almost like the Team MZ flag.

It’s a sandbag for practicing strikes. A note on it
says “Off-limits for Ivor!” in small writing.

What’d happen if the holo-tech
around the wild zones ever broke?

Your Pokémon are really fantastic.
They must love you raising them.

You sure are giving my Pokémon
an uncanny amount of attention...

I like buildings that face
out onto a Y junction.

If wild Pokémon never attacked innocent
bystanders, we wouldn’t need wild zones.

I get lonely sleeping by myself when I’m traveling,
so I always let my partner out of its Poké Ball.

Sableye is pretty unusual for having the Fairy type
as its only weakness.

The floor above my place is vacant,
yet I keep hearing this odd noise...

Maybe a Pokémon found a way
in and made itself at home?

If a Magikarp came flopping out,
I’d toss it right back in the river!

This old wives’ tale says that a Sharpedo tooth
will protect you from ever getting shipwrecked.

My Delibird sometimes gives me bug Pokémon as
little presents...

At some point while I was training Machop, I
realized that I love martial arts as well!

Your first-ever partner is
a pretty big choice, huh?

The Pokémon battles in that
restaurant had a real kick.

Furisode take a whole lot of work!
But they’re still all I want to wear!

Simply putting on a pair of specs
won’t help you see the truth.

I reckon even Pokémon must be taken by surprise
when the weather suddenly changes.

I want to make it snow for my Ice-type Pokémon
on superhot summer days!

Now that there are more Pokémon around, I hope
we’ll see even more mysterious things happen!

When night falls, my Lampent...
pulls double duty as my lamp.

Ending each day grooming my
Pokémon is all I could ever want.

Humans could learn a thing or two from Pokémon
about communication. We’re always running our<U+0010><U+0001>븀
mouths when we should stick to the essentials.

Think of a type that your first Pokémon is weak to,
then get a Pokémon strong against that type.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Next, identify one of that Pokémon’s weaknesses
and get a third Pokémon to counter it, and so on.<U+0010><U+0001>븀
That’s the real trick to building up your party.

How come we can’t just send packages to people
the same way we send Pokémon to Boxes?
La fin justifie les moyens.

Me and Buneary’s dream is
to pull off Mega Evolution!

I’ve got to recapture the wonder
from when I first became a Trainer.

Be their playmate
forever and ever!

What should I do to make
my Pokémon happy?

I’ll give your Furfrou
a real stylish trim! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Those heated gazes in the Z-A Royale... They reek
of danger.

People ride on Pokémon in some
regions but not others. It’s tricky.

Get lost on purpose!
You’ll discover new things.

If one person loses something,
another person gets to find it.

Ahhh, I can’t wait to eat.
I’m gonna stuff my face!

The city smells different now after it rains. Is it
something to do with all the new Pokémon?

Even if you don’t know the first thing about art,
anyone’s free to say what they do or don’t like.

I wonder if my first-ever Pokémon
will be with me to the very end.

I dress like this to match how
splendid my Pokémon are.

People can’t help showing off how
high-level their Pokémon is.

Remember, you’re free to do—
or not do—whatever you want!

Officer, you WILL be able to find my stolen
belongings, won’t you?

Our search Pokémon have a keen sense of smell,
but there’s a decent chance that a wild Pokémon<U+0010><U+0001>븀
already made off with the missing property.

The four of us are gonna
get strong with Pokémon!

We’re gonna be the
Elite Four someday!

Ugh, how’d I get
dragged into this...

But you two both
like the same type!

This life is too much some days...
I need my Pokémon to comfort me.

Think I’ll get my 15 minutes of
fame through the Z-A Royale?

Gramps... I’ve never even seen
you stay up past nine o’clock!

I like Pokémon battles, and yet the minute one
starts up, I feel so awfully stressed...

I’m not sure I want to hear that from someone
who joins the Z-A Royale with a smile every night.

I can’t get a wink of sleep after losing a battle.
And on the nights when I win my battles...?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Well, I can’t sleep, because I’m too pumped up!

It’s fun to grab a taxi just to hear the stories the
drivers have to tell.

I’m real strong in Pokémon battles!
I’m just also real weak in business!

It always seems to be one thing
after another in Lumiose City...

What should I play
with my Pidgey?

I wish I could just manage a
natural smile in front of her...

How may couriers would you say you’ve met since
you arrived in Lumiose City?

I work to fund my hobby—and I live for my hobby!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
What’s my hobby, you ask? Why, strolling with my
Pokémon while eating tasty food!

Perhaps for my next holiday I’ll go over the
mountains and visit the Paldea region.

It’s really just luck that I live such a good life. So
much of it is thanks to the people around me.

I just told her about some
memories from my travels.

I’m fascinated by
tales of Unova!

What a profound mystery it is...
The disappearance of O-Powers...

There sure are a lot of
teams here in Lumiose.

I myself am a member
of the Lumiose SBC.

I’m part of an occult fan club.
Though I’m the only member...

I’ll win my way to the top of the Z-A Royale with
my Beldum, then I’ll revive the Pokémon Fan Club!

They have those Z-Move things in Alola, right?
And Zygarde was there too...

Verily am I a member of the Pokédex Research
Society. If I could describe Carbink in an entry of<U+0010><U+0001>븀
my own devising, I would write...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
“Carbink that sleep deep underground are forced
by geological forces such as volcanic eruptions or<U+0010><U+0001>븀
earthquakes to rise to the surface, where they<U+0010><U+0001>븀
awaken from their slumber.”

We were having a little game of naming 10 things
we each like about one another’s Pokémon.

Please, I was a member of the Pokémon Fan Club!
I could easily name a hundred things!

It’s nice to take a little
stroll around the hotel.

Bunnelby digs holes to hide
from other Pokémon, you know.

Oh, Mom. It was just an overnight stay at the
hospital. You’re not about to die tomorrow!

But your Drampa doesn’t like anybody but you,
Grandma!

When I’m gone, can I count on you two to take
care of my partner for me?

Wait till I teach my
Pokémon that move!

You’re nowhere near
ready to beat me!

Boy, <U+E300>100 for a Casteliacone
was such a great bargain!

Not letting your guard slip
shows you respect an opponent.

I don’t know what’ll happen
in the future, so why worry!

I lost over and over yesterday...
but I feel like today I might win.

We ventured into one
of those wild zones...

Being swarmed by wild
Pokémon is truly frightful!

I guess I just go with whatever feels right when I
first meet them...?

Do you find out what your Pokémon will evolve
into before you give them a nickname?

If you want to train your Pokémon, you won’t get
far unless you take on tough foes.

Just keep walking. Eventually
you’re sure to get somewhere.

I heard it cost <U+E300>5,000,000 just to
join Team Flare back in the day.

Ahh, I can’t help but melt when
I smell Victreebel’s sweet scent!

I’m pretty sure I saw a Hawlucha-
themed manhole somewhere...

Me too! I’m sure I did!
Or at least I think I did.

Catering to Pokémon as customers
could be a business opportunity...

I wonder if Pokémon settle in
places people don’t tend to go. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I’m a member of the Pokédex Research Society!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
If I could write my own entry for Lairon, it’d say...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
“Lairon is super cool! And super hard! Because
Lairon eats up iron ore!”

It’s good to stay young at heart, but you also need
to be able to act like an adult when you start<U+0010><U+0001>븀
raising Pokémon of your own.

Do you think some Pokémon let
themselves be caught on purpose?

I just love couriers!
So I dress up like one!

Starmie’s category is the Mysterious Pokémon!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Seems kinda...dissatisfying, doesn’t it?

Everywhere I go becomes a splendid stage thanks
to my dazzling presence!

That summer I spent with my
Pokémon... Those days are gone.

Our complaints about all the
redevelopment go nowhere.

Have you heard that the sewers connect to all
kinds of different places in Lumiose?

Some of those sewers have been around for, like,
forever...

But there are lots of Pokémon that live down in
the sewers! Only strong Trainers can face them.

I’m just enjoying an elegant moment here on the
rooftop, buffeted by Pidgeotto’s moves.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Nothing to see here. Do carry on, commoner.

Look, different strokes for different folks and all,
but I think you’ll probably need a Pokémon Center<U+0010><U+0001>븀
if you keep on taking that many hits in a row...

The stronger the move you use,
the longer it will tend to take.

I have to win big in the Z-A Royale
so I can afford my Pokémon’s food!

I don’t just deliver packages.
I deliver wishes and feelings.

I’m hoping that martial arts will
teach me how to quiet my mind.

Not everyone has an easy time
walking about—we still need cars!

If you like lots of things,
you enjoy lots of things!

I’ll put my name on my Poké Balls
so the collectors see they’re mine.

All the redevelopment in the world isn’t going to
bring back the people who have left Lumiose.

Yeah, the Trainer’s level of
experience is important, too!

Just ’cause someone has a strong
team doesn’t mean they’ll win.

What do you think an ideal meal would look like
for a Pokémon?

I suppose it would vary by species. You’d have to
consider their different dietary needs too.

What do you think a Pokémon
would consider an ideal meal?

I wish my Pokémon could
share some vitality with me!

I’m gonna play with the Pokémon
I’d been keeping in my Boxes! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I still have my roller skates
tucked away somewhere... <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

The girls and I like to get together
and brag about our Pokémon. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

If only I could sleep
while standing up... <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

What should I do for that Pokémon research
assignment?
Maybe something about how they evolve?

See if you can find out why they can only
remember four moves at a time?

How they can become small enough to fit into a
Poké Ball?

Stealing travel bags is just the
sort of mischief Pokémon like.

It’s easiest to appreciate a city
like Lumiose when you leave it.

Life’s all about listening to tunes
I love and doing things I love. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

The only choice Pokémon have in battle is to trust
in their Trainer and use the moves they’re told to.

Yes, I think it’s SO important to have a trusting
relationship with your Pokémon when battling!

With all this construction, all our
working Pokémon are pitching in!

Even a single lap around the
plaza is a fair bit of exercise!

We don’t hafta come every day,
just ’cause it’s your favorite!

But they have the
BEST coffee here!

Standing all shift is rough.
My poor, swollen legs...

Losing and thinking about why is probably better
than winning by luck and not learning a thing.

I’m taking snapshots of everything I see so I can
post it all online!

Do you suppose really big
Pokémon have to eat a lot?

Shops around here don’t earn a
lot—everyone packs their lunch! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

If you’re here for the daily
special, it’s already sold out.

There’s no better way to spend
a day off than with a picnic.

We’ve come here to enjoy the sun
since we were little girls, huh?

Two cups of coffee per day.
That’s my personal style.

No matter what happens,
I’ll never leave Jaune Plaza. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I wish they’d transfer me
to a different district...

My friend always comes bragging to me ’bout
how many Pokémon he’s caught!

Don’t listen to him. All you need is a couple
Pokémon, if they’re ones you really love!

The people of Lumiose always gather in the plazas
when something is going on.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I suppose it’s the same for the Pokémon now.

I just like to sit here on the bench when I don’t
have plans and watch what happens in the plaza.

Behold! I’m the man who collected
one thousand coins in Paldea! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Origami is pretty popular in
Lumiose too—did you know?

Anyone can become an Ace Trainer if
they’ve got a deep love for Pokémon!

I want to style my outfit
to match my Pokémon!

Get chased down by a terrifying
Pokémon, and it’ll traumatize you.

Our coffee is loved by Pokémon—
and hated by all the people.

I wonder what our Pokémon think about the
increase in wild Pokémon around here?

Even my battle-hardened Sharpedo seems on
edge with all these wild Pokémon about.

We should always be kind to
Pokémon as well as people.

I want to work in an office that has Pokémon in it.
It sounds so relaxing, right?

Yeah, that’d be great... Pokémon don’t care about
what time you show up or sign off...

So, who do we all think will
win big in the Z-A Royale?

Just tracking the rankings in
the Z-A app is fun enough.

My money’s definitely on
Jacinthe. Hands down.

If we’re going by who looks
tough, then it’s gotta be Ivor!

Sometimes you’re just too tired to
get mad—it’s not about being nice.

Trading with someone from a faraway region will
get you a Pokémon that’s a bit easier to raise!

If it looks like I’ll lose, I just run away! Gotta live to
fight another day and complete my collection!

I trained for a while with the Fist of Justice, but I
still don’t think I could beat a wild Pokémon.
